entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical thing. The pulse readings are completely wrong, jumping all over the place. Honestly, the product feels like garbage. I'm so disappointed.

I see, I apologize for the trouble it's giving you. Inconsistent readings can sometimes be fixed with a quick software update or recalibration. Would you be open to trying a few troubleshooting steps with me?
No, I'm sorry, I just don't have time for that. I've been a loyal customer for a while and I just expected it to work. I really just want my money back. I need the refund.

I understand your frustration. Of course. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, the email is sadcustomer@email.com. I really needed that money... I saved up for this and it's just been a letdown.
I understand completely, and I'm very sorry for your experience. One moment while I review your account... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 37 days ago.
Yes, that sounds about right. I hope that's not a problem.

Not at all. I'm just checking our policy... and yes, you're perfectly fine. Our return policy covers items for 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I really appreciate you helping me.

You're very welcome. I'm generating a prepaid return label and it should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
That's wonderful. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help.
Happy I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
